title: Lawn parties and fish fries
summary: Howard and the interviewer discuss lawn parties and fish fries, who hires bands and which nights they were held.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Speaking of parties, we'll come back to your buddy McKee again in a minute if I think there's something to ask. Did you ever play many fish fries or lawn parties? Can you tell me anything about those?
Yeah, well like Red Island, all of us played those lawn parties. That's open in the yard.

I went to about two of them is all I ever went to in my life. Did they ever run them? I understand some people like Betsy Cole, Miss Cole's lawn parties uptown had them every week. But some people, did they just put on a party maybe once a summer and have it a lawn party? Or did people have it regular every week at their house or what?

Well the lawn parties, well it depends. Just like right across the street here. They have in the summertime, they have either fish fry or they have a party with music or you know. And that's the way that people rent your yard or foot-a-law and park. Oh yeah, that's right.
Is that the place where they record the Eureka band?
Right across the street.
In there?
Yeah, that's right. I forgot about that. Yeah, that's right across the street. They're about the regular there then. In the summertime, yeah. Still do?
Sure. Who plays those? I never know anything about them.
Well different people who's given it, they hire what they want.
Some good bands sometimes.
Well they have maybe three or four pieces but the noise, you see. And that's the way that goes. Yeah.

I wonder if people hired bands sometimes just like to pay their own rent or something, you know, like in Chicago they used to have these house rent parties. No, no. Were the fish fries ever used for that purpose? No, not that I know.
When the people give us something, they used to have fish fries way back but they have suppers now. You see across the street or they have it in their home, you know that'd be for their own put.
Is it true that the fish fries used to be mostly Saturday night only? Saturday night, that's right.
Only. Only on Saturday night.
That's right. And the lawn parties, when would they be? Any old time?
Well it could be Saturday or Sunday and sometimes they'd have more Mondays, between those three days.
The ones I went to were both Sunday nights?
Well some would have more Mondays or Saturday or Sunday, like I said. What about picnics?
